g.text: Better point predictions. Consistent posterior inference.
One Bayesian linear regression model | 331 training observations | 83 held-out observations
Lower is better. Both methods use the same test set.
Points: posterior means. Lines: marginal 95% credible intervals.
Each coefficient uses its own x-axis scale.
